candidates.name: legacy_unconstrained
candidates.role: historical baseline regenerated only if a v2 physics report is unavailable

candidates.name: distal_bound
candidates.role: isolates the effect of limiting visible distal hyperextension

candidates.name: coupled_flexion
candidates.role: tests hard middle/distal bounds plus a weak PIP-DIP coordination prior

selection_rule: first require zero trajectories below the configured anatomical lower bounds; then maximize stable 30 cm terminal success, compare paired gains/losses, and use keypoint loss only as a diagnostic tie-breaker
escalation_rule: the best constrained candidate must next pass one train trajectory from all 50 categories before replacing the formal Wuji method
